inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: A 7 week old infant was observed alseep in a restrictive device with a blanket. An 11 month old was observed asleep on a 'boppy' pillow with a blanket outside of a crib.    Once addressed by the inspector, the caregiver moved sleeping infants into their cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: A caregiver was observed on their phone when temporarily watching class for the director who was handling adminstrative tasks with CCR inspector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: The caregiver in charge of the infant room, during lunch coverage, was observed out of the classroom leaving two infants with no caregiver to supervise them.     Once addressed, the caregiver went back to the infant classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: Parent Provided Snacks - May be Shared with Other Children if for Celebration or Party at Center: A caregiver was reported to have shared their child's food with another child without parent's permission.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parent Provided Snacks - May be Shared with Other Children if for Celebration or Party at Center (26 TAC §746.3309(d)(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: The operation was unable to provide a copy of the written infant report to CCR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The bathroom floor and baseboards had visible dirt marks. A bathroom ceiling tile appeared to have been molded with water stains.The kitchen floor appeared to have dirt marks on the ground and on the baseboards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The director could not provide a sanitation inspection for a second time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The playground mulch was observed to be less than an inch deep during the follow-up inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment: The operation did not have the proper sanitation process for dishes.    Multiple toys in the classroom and on the large playground were observed to have layers of debris during the follow-up inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407(11))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: Trash was observed on the playground while children were present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: There was bug spray observed accesible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The playground mulch was observed to be less than an inch deep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The playground fence was observed to have two entrapment and splinter hazards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment: The operation did not have the proper sanitation process for dishes.    Multiple toys in the classroom and on the large playground were observed to have layers of debris.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407(11))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The toddler room classroom was observed to have chipping paint on the wall and the gate. The bathroom floor had visible dirt marks. A bathroom ceiling tile appeared to have been molded with water stains.There were three trash cans accessible to children.The kitchen floor appeared to have dirt marks on the ground and on the baseboards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The director could not provide a sanitation inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Exceeding Maximum Group Size -Ratio Meet: All classes of children at the operation were observed to be combined on the playground with one caregiver for 3-4minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Exceeding Maximum Group Size -Ratio Meet (26 TAC §746.1611(b))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving: One employee was observed to have an active background check after seperating from the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employees Required: An additional person was not in the building during nap time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employees Required (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Walls near sink was observed to have paint peeling and dirt/soap scum stains in the older infant room.    Bathroom was observed to have soiled diapers child's water bottle, and toilet paper on the floor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: This standard was re-cited. The loose fill was not at the proper depth around the climbing equipment as required. The equipment is not in use at this time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The loose fill on the playground was observed to be less than 1 inch in front of the large slide.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children: During inspection the caregiver had 10 children 9 that were 18m to 3 yr old with one infant, making the caregiver out of ratio with 12 or fewer children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1701)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: During inspection of the playground there were 2 buckets of water observed on the playground that had material settled in the buckets and standing water, more than 8 inches, in the buckets accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The annual Health inspection has not been completed since April.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Children recrods were reviewed and 4 records were missing the Parents rights, 2 records were mimssing the immunizations, 1 record was missing the health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There is a piece of soft play equipment that is in the infant room that has become worn and torn and can no longer be sanitized properly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid kit was missing tweezers and thermometer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Sanitizing equipment was within the child's reach in the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A crib that an infant was sleeping in had a bottle and a blanket it in with the infant. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver removed the items from the infants crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: There were empty food cans (like what green beans come in) that were accessible to children. These cans could cut the children hands if they picked them up. This was corrected as inspection when the cans were removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: During the follow-up the liability insurance policy unavailable for review. The most recent policy expired on 1/31/2024.       9/27/2024-There still was no active liability policy available for review.  Director stated she sent the notice to inform the parents of no liabilty insurance on the operation back in March 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §746.203(2))

occurrences.finding: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: The illumination within the initial classroom appears to be malfunctioning and requires immediate attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §746.3407(10))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: There were many tripping hazards present in both play areas.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: There were no fire drills log avaiable for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Neither the director nor the caregiver had CPR and First Aid certification for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: There were no active liability insurance policy available for review. The most recent policy expired on 1/31/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §746.203(2))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: There were many tripping hazards present in both play areas. This was corrected when the director moved the toys and organized to eliminate tripping hazards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: Trainings were not available during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: There were several walls and equipment that needed cleaning or replacing. There were dead crickets throughout the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: 1 out of 4 children were missing some shots.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: 1 out of 4 staff was missing a notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the walktrhough, there were piles of items and clutter causing a tripping hazard and possible health and safety hazareds.    The following items were observed and accessible to children:    Pile of clothing and blankets.    Stacked area of open plastic bins containing clothing and supplies. Some supplies are spilling out of the containers onto the floor covering the walking area.    Shelves with a bottle of sode and can or pringles.    Chairs, foam tiles and other items on the floor of the changing area.     Rugs with visible dirt and trash.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: 1 out of 4 staff files were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: During an inspection, children were observed unsupervised during several incidents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age: An 8 mo old, non walking infant was in a classroom (during naptime) without a crib for sleeping.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2405(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: A child was observed sleeping in a bouncy seat. This was corrected when the child was removed from the seat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: One classroom was over ratio with one caregiver supervising 10 children ages 8mo-3 years old with a SAG of 18-24mo.     This was corrected at inspection when additional caregivers returned from lunch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: A garbage can was observed to be full of garbage without a lid, and accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: An 8 mo old child was combined in a room with a 3 year old child (exceeding 18 mo age gap).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)
